Harmonised Index of Consumer Prices (HICP)

Source: R/ecb_hicp.R
ecb_hicp.Rd

Returns HICP inflation data for one or more euro area countries or country groups. The default is the euro area aggregate ("U2", the euro area in its changing composition: 21 members since Bulgaria joined on 1 January 2026).

Usage

ecb_hicp(
  country = "U2",
  measure = c("annual_rate", "index", "monthly_rate"),
  from = NULL,
  to = NULL,
  cache = TRUE
)

Arguments

country

Character vector of country codes. Use "U2" for the euro area aggregate, or ISO 2-letter codes such as "DE" (Germany), "FR" (France), "IT" (Italy), "ES" (Spain).

measure

One of:

  • "annual_rate" (default) – year-on-year percentage change

  • "index" – index level (2025 = 100)

  • "monthly_rate" – month-on-month percentage change. The ECB does not publish this series, so it is computed from the index; the first month of the requested range is therefore dropped.

from

Optional start date.

to

Optional end date.

cache

Logical. Use cached data if available (default TRUE).

Value

A data frame with columns:

date

Date.

country

Character. Country or area code.

value

Numeric. Inflation rate or index level.

Details

Data come from the ECB's HICP dataflow, which replaced the ICP dataflow when Eurostat moved the HICP to the ECOICOP 2 classification in 2026. The ICP series stop at December 2025.

Examples

# \donttest{
op <- options(readecb.cache_dir = tempdir())
try({
  ecb_hicp(from = "2020-01")
  ecb_hicp(c("DE", "FR", "IT"), from = "2023-01")
  ecb_hicp(measure = "monthly_rate", from = "2025-01")
})
